<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN"><head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>CaseRecord · 报告详情</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/style.css">
</head>
<body>
  <main class="page dash">
    <a class="back" href="case-detail.html?id=2026-08-16" id="back-link">← 返回病例详情</a>

    <div class="brand">CaseRecord · 病例档案</div>

    <nav class="topnav">
      <span class="topnav-slider" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <a class="topnav-link active" href="dashboard.html">我的档案</a>
      <a class="topnav-link" href="case.html">添加病例</a>
    </nav>

    <header>
      <h1>报告详情</h1>
      <p class="sub" id="report-meta">记录于 2026/8/16 13:47:13</p>
    </header>

    <!-- 报告 + AI 识别/解析：两栏布局 -->
    <section class="card report-layout">
      <!-- 左栏：原始报告 -->
      <div class="report-left">
        <div class="section-title">原始报告</div>
        <div id="report-content"><img class="report-img" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="4f02c7f17c5e5a5a0062c4e71fb05f5f.png"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- 右栏：进入即自动识别（视觉模型看原图）+ 检验项目表格 + AI 解析 -->
      <div class="report-right">
        <div class="ai-parse">
          <div class="section-title-row">
            <span class="section-title">AI 识别</span>
            <div class="case-note-head-actions">
              <span class="note-timer" id="ai-timer" hidden=""></span>
              <button type="button" class="btn-rerun" id="btn-rerun-ocr">↻ 重新识别</button>
              <button type="button" class="btn-ai-note" id="btn-ai-parse" hidden="">✦ AI 解析</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p class="case-note-tip" id="ai-tip">进入页面后自动调用视觉模型识别报告原图文字，识别结果已保存到本地、刷新不重复识别；点「↻ 重新识别」可重新识别并覆盖。AI 解析仅本次展示、不保存。</p>

          <div class="ai-recog-status ok" id="ai-recog-status">已载入上次识别结果（2026/8/16 17:56:40），无需重新识别；可修改表格后点击「AI 解析」。</div>

          <!-- 检验报告：识别文字 → 提取检验项目表格 -->
          <div id="lab-table-block" hidden="">
            <div class="ocr-text-title">检验项目
              <span class="ocr-check-tag">由识别文字自动提取，可修改</span>
              <span class="lab-count" id="lab-count">共 0 项</span>
            </div>
            <div class="lab-table-scroll">
              <table class="lab-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th style="width:30%">项目</th>
                    <th style="width:20%">结果</th>
                    <th style="width:13%">单位</th>
                    <th style="width:24%">参考范围</th>
                    <th style="width:13%">状态</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody id="lab-tbody"></tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <div class="lab-table-actions">
              <button type="button" class="btn-rerun" id="btn-add-row">＋ 添加项目</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- AI 解析：合并到识别下方（检验手动 / 检查自动） -->
          <div class="ocr-text-title" style="margin-top:1.2rem">AI 解析 <span class="ocr-check-tag">文本模型基于识别文字</span></div>
          <textarea id="ai-parse-result" rows="12" readonly="" placeholder="已载入识别结果，点击「AI 解析」生成解析…"></textarea>
          <div class="case-note-foot">
            <span class="case-note-meta" id="ai-meta">本次耗时 1786874797 秒 · Token 用量：729（输入 427 / 输出 302） · 时间：2026/8/16 18:06:37</span>
            <span class="case-note-hint" id="ai-hint">本次解析，未保存</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <div class="toast" id="toast" role="status"></div>

  <!-- AI 识别/解析结果弹窗（灰色遮罩 + 屏幕上方） -->
  <div class="modal-mask" id="ai-test-mask" hidden="">
    <div class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="AI 识别与解析">
      <div class="modal-head">
        <div class="modal-title" id="ai-test-title">AI 识别与解析</div>
        <button type="button" class="modal-close" id="ai-test-close" aria-label="关闭">×</button>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-body">
        <div class="ai-test-box" id="ai-test-box"></div>
        <div class="ai-test-interpret" id="ai-test-interpret" hidden=""></div>
        <div class="modal-actions">
          <button type="button" class="modal-btn-cancel ai-test-ok" id="ai-test-ok">确定</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script src="js/store.js"></script>
  <script src="js/report-detail.js"></script>


</body></html>
